evidence: docs/evidence/2026-08-23-cycle13-mutation-proof-portable-copies.txt:31-43 preserves the published sentence and adds one dated correction that distinguishes the cycle-13 test from the uncommitted survival probe.
tests/test_assess_clients.py:606-637 now waits for and asserts the escaped descendant marker.
The focused escaped-descendant test passed on revision df67a2d.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolved by preserving the historical sentence, adding the dated narrowing correction, and making the current test observe the marker.
findings.title: Mutation proof overstates escaped-session coverage
findings.why_it_matters: The committed cycle-13 proof said its test observed escaped-descendant survival when that version of the test did not read the marker.

evidence: scripts/assess_clients.py:837-851 and scripts/assess_clients.py:879-899 enforce and serialize exactly one of exit_status or timed_out for both public and private representations.
scripts/assess_clients.py:1188-1206 records a deadline kill as timed_out true with no exit status in both representations.
scripts/check_compatibility_matrix.py:716-737 refuses both endings and neither ending; tests/test_assess_clients.py:1258-1278 proves exit_status -1 remains SIGHUP.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolved by the explicit timed_out representation and matched producer, transcript, schema, validator, runbook, and behavior tests.
findings.title: Timeout sentinel collides with real signal status
findings.why_it_matters: A deadline kill and a real SIGHUP must remain distinguishable in both the public record and private transcript.

evidence: scripts/assess_clients.py:1428-1467 requires an existing empty directory, resolves symlinks, rejects the workspace itself, and checks resolved containment when a workspace is supplied.
tests/test_assess_clients.py:782-865 exercises occupied, missing, outside-workspace, workspace-itself, and accepted empty-subdirectory cases.

Direct probes confirmed outside symlinks are refused, inside symlinks and relative paths normalize to contained resolved directories, and workspace None follows the documented conditional containment rule.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolved for the supported caller contract by validating the supplied directory before assessment and retaining atomic allocation in the command-line path.
findings.title: Supplied run directories bypass freshness
findings.why_it_matters: A reused run directory can mix package copies and overwrite the private transcript unless the caller-supplied path preserves the one-run-one-directory boundary.

evidence: scripts/check_compatibility_matrix.py:782-804 checks the alias whenever a non-empty commands list and command are both present, without an executed-only skip.
tests/test_check_compatibility_matrix.py:465-490 probes disagreeing blocked and not-applicable rows.
A direct disagreeing blocked-row probe returned the expected alias error.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolved by moving alias validation outside the executed-only requirement and adding blocked-row behavior coverage.
findings.title: Blocked command aliases escape validation
findings.why_it_matters: A blocked version-2 row must not name one first command through command and another through commands[0].command.

evidence: scripts/assess_clients.py:1142-1152 returns a new blocked StageOutcome without the accumulated recorded_commands, transcript, or statuses.
A fake-executable probe ran the first argv, made the later argv absent from PATH, and observed result blocked with command first-ok but empty commands and transcript.

scripts/assess_clients.py:1048-1082 generates every current multi-command stage with one repeated executable, so this needs external executable removal during the stage and is not an ordinary stable-PATH path.
findings.suggested_fix: When a later argv is absent, carry tuple(recorded_commands), tuple(transcript), and tuple(statuses) into the blocked StageOutcome, then add a two-argv regression.
findings.title: Later missing executable drops prior evidence
findings.why_it_matters: If an executable disappears after an earlier argv completes, the blocked stage loses the completed command statuses and transcript that explain the partial run.
